description: Source code for sensing data dispatching in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for client data consumption timing, data sending, and a dispatch thread.

methods.name: sensor_test_consume_time
methods.description: Checks if the current time is appropriate for the client to consume the sensor data.

methods.name: update_client_consume_time
methods.description: Updates the next consume time for a client based on its interval.

methods.name: send_data_to_clients
methods.description: Sends sensor data to clients if their consume time has arrived and they requested data.

methods.name: dispatch_task
methods.description: Main dispatch thread function that processes RTIO events and sends data to sensors.
